rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.ny.2025.whole_dollars (owner decision C4; IT-201-I p. 7, "Enter only whole dollar amounts on your New York return."; p. 2, "Increase amounts that are 50 cents or more to the next dollar."). Evaluated on a grid of whole-dollar amounts for every status (scratch evaluator, params/ny/2025.yaml): the reply differs from the project only by the cents of the band product, never more than 50 cents; the bands' "over" amounts equal the previous bands' upper limits, so the reordered guards select the same band.
